title: Digital Platform and Website Executive
description:
Digital Platform and Website Executive (2687)
- Location:Oxford UK/ (with the ability to work from home under Oxfam GB's hybrid working arrangements)
- Workplace Type:Hybrid
- Hours:36 hours per week
- Salary:£28,057 with a discretionary range up to £30,761 depending on experience
- Job Family:Communications
- Division:CEO Office
- Grade:D
- Job Type:Open ended
- Closing Date:22 November 2026
- Country:United Kingdom

Oxfam is a global movement of people working together to end the injustice of poverty.

About the Role:

As part of an established team of digital experts, you'll play a key role in triaging and actioning website content update requests and digital platform management requests, whilst liaising with teams across Oxfam GB. You'll also support quality assurance activities and help ensure our digital platforms run smoothly and deliver a positive user experience.

This is a great role for someone at any stage of their career who likes variety, can work autonomously and wants to grow their digital expertise.

Because the website is on a content management system (CMS), this role does not require any coding experience.

Location: Oxford-based (Hybrid with up to 2 team days in the Oxford office per month required)

If you have any questions about the role, we'd love to hear from you.Please e-mail us at , making sure you include the job title and reference number of the role you're asking about.Please be aware we are unable to accept CVs or applications via e-mail.To apply, please use the "apply now" button on the right hand side of this advertisement

Your Cover Letter:

We are looking to interview people who share our values. Therefore, we ask applicants to write a covering letter answering these questions:
- How have you actively challenged your own unconscious biases and have worked to correct inequalities in the workplace?
- How do you support people's freedom to express ideas and opinions while also making sure no one faces discrimination?

If you find these questions hard to answer, think about what these points mean to you and share your thoughts and how they reflect your personal values.

Key Responsibilities:
- Triaging and actioning day-to-day website content updates.
- Edit, format, and publish web pages, blogs and media using our content management system (CMS).
- Administer digital platforms: support user permissions, cloud services, identify and fix broken links, test functionality and report technical issues.

We're looking for someone who has:
- Familiarity with CMS platforms and web design principles.
- Strong communication and organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- A commitment to Oxfam's values, feminist principles and safeguarding requirements.

It would be a bonus if you also have familiarity with:
- AI and other technologies to improve processes and save time.
- Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
- Project management and work tracking software, i.e. Jira, Trello or Monday.
- User Experience (UX) design methodologies.

We offer:

We offer a competitive salary and a range of additional benefits to staff including flexible working options, generous pension scheme, annual leave, additional leave allowances, company sick pay, life assurance and a range of other benefits.

From the day you join Oxfam we invite you to stretch and learn in your role. Our wide range of Learning & Development opportunities includes in-house courses, e-learning modules, on-the job learning opportunities, coaching and mentoring, and much more.

You can read more about all Oxfam has to offer

How to apply:

As part of your online application, please upload your up to date CV and Cover Letter (see format above) explaining your suitability against the essential criteria in the job profile.

Our values and commitment to safeguarding

Oxfam is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour at work including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct; and committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults and beneficiaries with whom Oxfam GB engages. Oxfam expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We place a high priority on ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our are recruited to work for us.

The post holder will undertake the appropriate level of training and is responsible for ensuring that they understand and work within the safeguarding policies of the organisation.

All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records and terrorism finance checks. Oxfam GB also participates in the .In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants' previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her understanding of these recruitment procedures.

We are committed to ensuring diversity and gender equality within our organisation and encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply.

About us

Oxfam is a global community who believe poverty isn't inevitable. It's an injustice that can be overcome. We are shop volunteers, women's right activists, marathon runners, aid workers, coffee farmers, street fundraisers, goat herders, policy experts, campaigners, water engineers and more. And we won't stop until everyone can live life without poverty for good.

is a member of of 21 organisations working together with partners and local communities in the areas of humanitarian, development and campaigning, in more than 90 countries.

A thriving diverse Oxfam:

It's people power that brings about change. To play our part as a global organisation working to overcome poverty and inequality, we need equality, diversity and inclusion across our community of staff, partners and volunteers. Together, we're committed to becoming a more diverse workforce, better able to tackle the global challenges that face our world today.

To do that:
- We need to dismantle the unequal power structures that exist everywhere, this including Oxfam and the wider development and charity sectors.
- We need an inclusive Oxfam where everyone can bring who they are to our work and feels celebrated for the differences they bring.
- We want and need everyone, and that means we need you.

title: Direct Despatch Administrator - E-Commerce Team
company: MP Jobs Ltd t/a MP Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
advertiser_name: MP Jobs Ltd t/a MP Recruitment Group
description:
Direct Despatch Administrator

Join a busy, fast-paced team where organisation, accuracy and teamwork make a real difference!

Are you highly organised, confident with Excel and enjoy keeping things running smoothly? We're looking for a proactive Direct Despatch Administrator to join our E-Commerce team, supporting the day-to-day management of customer orders, stock availability and sales administration. This is a varied role where you'll work closely with customers, sales teams, warehouse and finance colleagues to ensure orders are processed efficiently, deliveries run smoothly and customers receive an excellent service.Previous experience with B2 B portals would be an advantage, but it's not essential. Full training will be provided, making this an excellent opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills who enjoys working with data, solving problems and being part of a supportive team.

Please note: This is a fully office-based position, with some bank holiday working required.

Responsibilities as a Despatch Administrator:
- Managing Customer Orders: Importing and processing orders from B2 B portals into the internal Sage system using Excel, ensuring all information is accurate and up to date.
- Keeping Sales on Track: Monitoring stock allocations, reservations and forecasts to help maximise sales opportunities with dropship customers.
- Building Customer Relationships: Liaising with buyers and stock management teams to provide updates on order progress, stock availability and delivery schedules.
- Supporting Sales Performance: Maintaining customer listings and price lists, preparing sales figures for Key Sales Managers and helping create engaging sales presentations.
- Resolving Queries: Acting as a key contact for order and invoice queries, working with customers and internal teams to resolve issues quickly and professionally.
- Managing Returns and Credits: Using Sage to raise sales orders, credits and debits where products are faulty, damaged or no longer required.
- Working Across Teams: Collaborating with warehouse and finance colleagues to keep orders moving and ensure everything runs efficiently.
- Supporting E-Commerce Operations: Assisting with product imports, product information, sample requests and general order processing.

About you:
- Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Confident IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise a varied workload.
- Clear communication skills and a professional, customer-focused approach.
- A positive, can-do attitude and the ability to work collaboratively.
- The confidence to work under pressure while maintaining high standards.

Experience with B2 B portals or order-processing systems would be beneficial, but it's not essential.

We're happy to provide comprehensive training for someone with the right attitude, aptitude and willingness to learn.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to become an important part of a busy E-Commerce team, gaining exposure to sales administration, customer relationships, stock management and order fulfilment. No two days need to be the same, and you'll play a key role in helping the business deliver an efficient and reliable service to its customers. If you're organised, enthusiastic and enjoy being at the heart of a team that gets things done, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Events & Marketing Executive
description:
3288 - Events & Marketing Executive West Oxfordshire (4 days in office / 1 from home) Perm £30 -£35 K

Are you a creative, highly organised marketing professional with a passion for events?

We're looking for a proactive Marketing & Events Executive to join a growing, international business within the specialist training and education sector.

This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll take ownership of an extensive programme of events, exhibitions, open days, school visits and recruitment activities across the UK and Europe.

Working closely with the Head of Marketing and wider teams, you'll play a key role in raising brand awareness, engaging prospective students and supporting the organisation's ongoing growth.

The Role

You'll be responsible for planning, coordinating and delivering a busy programme of marketing and events activity, including:
- Organising exhibitions, open days, careers fairs and recruitment events across the UK and Europe.
- Managing all event logistics, including venues, suppliers, travel, accommodation, exhibition stands and promotional materials.
- Building relationships with schools, colleges, universities, careers advisers and external partners.
- Coordinating event registrations, attendee communications and post-event follow-up.
- Supporting integrated marketing campaigns across social media, email and website channels.
- Creating and coordinating marketing collateral, presentations, brochures and promotional content.
- Managing CRM records, tracking enquiries and working with the Sales team to ensure effective follow-up.
- Monitoring event budgets, reporting on performance and identifying opportunities to improve results.

About You

We're looking for someone who can combine excellent organisation with creativity and commercial awareness.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous marketing experience, with strong hands-on experience organising and delivering events.
- Experience coordinating multiple events, exhibitions or recruitment activities.
- Excellent project management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Experience using CRM systems and managing contact databases.
- A good understanding of marketing campaigns, digital marketing and event promotion.
- Strong communication skills and confidence building relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
- Experience managing suppliers, budgets and event logistics.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong Microsoft Office skills.

Experience within education, student recruitment would be advantageous, as would familiarity with Zoho or HubSpot CRM.

Important: This role involves regular weekend working as a key part of the events programme, occasional evenings and travel across the UK and Europe.

What's on Offer?
- Salary up to £35,000.
- 25 days' holiday, increasing with service, plus bank holidays.
- Enhanced pension contributions.
- Enhanced sick pay and leave.
- Life assurance and critical illness cover.
- Personal development and training opportunities.
- Wellbeing day.
- Cycle to work scheme.
- Free on-site parking.
- Employee referral scheme and lifestyle discounts.

Interested?

This is a fantastic opportunity for an enthusiastic Marketing & Events Executive to take ownership of a varied events programme, work across international markets and make a real contribution to a growing organisation.

Apply today to find out more.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Enable the successful delivery of Gigaclear s marketing strategy by providing outstanding campaign coordination, marketing operations, and team support.

The role is designed to provide you with broad exposure across every marketing discipline, creating a strong foundation for future progression into Brand, Performance, Customer Lifecycle or B2 B Marketing. It offers an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketer to build commercial experience, develop specialist expertise and grow their career within a high-performing Marketing function.

We are building a modern, commercially focused marketing function that combines creativity, customer insight, and operational excellence to support profitable growth. You will play a central role in supporting the successful delivery of our marketing activity, providing day-to-day coordination across campaigns, brand activity, community marketing, and wider marketing operations.

You will primarily support the planning and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns whilst also providing operational support across the wider Marketing team.

Working alongside Brand, Performance, Customer Lifecycle and B2 B Marketing colleagues, you will help coordinate campaigns, manage agencies, monitor budgets, and ensure marketing projects are delivered efficiently and to a consistently high standard.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Planning & Co-Ordination

Support the planning, coordination, and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns across Consumer and Business markets.

Coordinate campaign timelines, schedules, and marketing activity, ensuring projects are delivered on time and key milestones are achieved.

Support campaign launches by coordinating creative assets, approvals, communications, and campaign logistics.

Brand & Community Marketing Support

Provide day-to-day support to the Senior Brand, Campaigns & Community Marketing Manager in delivering Gigaclear s brand and community marketing programmes.

Assist with local marketing initiatives, sponsorship activity, community events, and network launch campaigns.

Coordinate the production and distribution of marketing collateral and promotional materials.

Marketing Operations

Support the smooth operation of the Marketing function through effective planning, organisation, and administration.

Maintain the marketing calendar, campaign schedules, and project plans, ensuring the wider team has visibility of upcoming activity and priorities.

Agency Supplier Co-Ordination

Act as the day-to-day contact for creative agencies, media partners, printers, production suppliers, and other marketing vendors.

Coordinate agency briefings, meetings, project timelines, and deliverables.

Monitor agency performance against agreed timelines and quality standards, escalating risks where appropriate.

Marketing Asset Management

Maintain Gigaclear s marketing asset library, ensuring campaign materials, photography, creative assets, and brand resources are organised, accessible and up to date.

Coordinate the production, storage, and distribution of marketing materials across the business.

Marketing Reporting & Administration

Support the preparation of campaign reports, presentations, and performance updates.

Work with the Commercial Insight & Intelligence team to collate campaign results and assist in the preparation of post-campaign reviews.

Maintain accurate marketing records and assist with reporting on campaign activity, budgets, and marketing performance.

Support Wider Marketing Team

Provide flexible support across the Marketing function as business priorities evolve.

Assist the wider team with campaign coordination, events, content production, customer communications, marketing administration, and proposition launches.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Some experience in a marketing coordination, marketing executive, campaign administration, or marketing operations role, either in-house or within a marketing agency.

Excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Experience supporting campaign delivery, managing budgets, and coordinating agencies.

Experience with project management tools, digital asset management systems, CRM platforms, or marketing automation tools would be advantageous but is not essential.

You will be proactive, collaborative, highly organised and genuinely motivated to build a long-term career in marketing.

Gigaclear is a leading alternative operator of rural full fibre broadband networks in the UK. Offering customers a truly world class product, we are developing our fibre-to-the-premises broadband (FTTP / FTTH) infrastructure to some of the most difficult to reach areas of the UK, empowering those communities with broadband to rival any city.

Staff rewards, benefits and opportunities

We foster a collaborative, engaging culture that empowers staff to grow and maximise their skills. We want to challenge our people in a fair environment where hard work is rewarded and a path for progression is open to all.
- Generous employer pension; up to 8% matched contribution
- Income protection & life assurance
- 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), holiday purchase scheme and Yay Days!
- Health cash plan, 24/7 remote GP access and Employee Assistance Programme including counselling & legal advice
- Unlimited access to online training and development content via our Learning Management System
- Long service benefits and monthly employee recognition
- Enhanced maternity and paternity provisions
- Flexible working environment
- Health & Wellbeing initiatives and company funded social events

Our approach is to work guided by our mission, vision and values.

Our Mission - Empowering communities with brilliant broadband

Our Vision - Connected Communities

Our Values - Own it, Find the Right Way, Work Together, Win Together

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
Hybrid Full Time Permanent
About the Employer
An established UK technology business providing IT infrastructure, data protection, disaster recovery and enterprise technology solutions to organisations across a range of sectors. Working closely with leading global technology vendors, the company combines specialist technical expertise with long-standing industry experience to help customers protect, manage and modernise business-critical IT environments.
The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a hands-on Marketing Executive to join a growing B2 B technology marketing team. This practical, delivery-focused position will play an important role in turning marketing strategies into effective, measurable campaigns across digital channels.
Working closely with marketing, sales and SDR colleagues, you will build and manage campaigns in HubSpot, create landing pages and email sequences, develop marketing assets, support PPC and social media activity, and monitor campaign performance. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised marketer looking to develop their expertise in B2 B technology, campaign management and digital marketing.
Duties & Responsibilities
- Build and manage integrated marketing campaigns in HubSpot, including emails, landing pages, forms, lists, workflows and associated campaign assets.
- Maintain and organise the HubSpot portal to ensure campaigns, marketing assets, data and reporting remain accurate and consistent.
- Produce campaign reports and dashboards, monitoring marketing performance against agreed KPIs and objectives.
- Create professional landing pages, email campaigns and marketing resources in line with established brand and editorial guidelines.
- Plan, create and publish engaging social media content, particularly for LinkedIn, while supporting paid digital and PPC campaigns.
- Collaborate with marketing, SDR and sales teams to understand briefs and deliver both long-term campaigns and fast-turnaround marketing projects.
- Create and adapt visual marketing assets using Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud applications, while supporting website content development and management.
- Support channel and co-marketing campaigns with major technology vendors and strategic partners.

Education & Skills Required
- A degree in marketing or a related discipline, or an equivalent professional marketing qualification such as CIM, would be advantageous.
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within B2 B IT, technology or a channel environment such as a vendor, reseller, MSP or technology partner.
- Strong HubSpot skills covering campaign creation, management, automation, organisation, reporting and performance measurement.
- Experience creating professional landing pages, email campaigns, digital marketing content and associated campaign assets.
- Working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, combined with excellent written and spoken English and strong attention to detail.
- An organised, collaborative and dependable approach, with the ability to manage varied workloads, meet deadlines and communicate effectively with sales, SDR and marketing stakeholders. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
- Hybrid.
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:30pm.
- Banbury.
- Salary: 30 k to 35 k. (Depending on experience)
If you are an enthusiastic and detail-focused Marketing Executive looking to develop your career within the B2 B technology sector, this is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of meaningful campaigns and expand your digital marketing expertise. Apply today to take the next step in your marketing career.

title: Senior Digital Communications Officer
description:
Senior Digital Communications Officer

Are you an experienced digital communications professional who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on content creation Do you enjoy telling compelling stories, growing online engagement and helping organisations communicate with clarity and impact

We are seeking a talented and creative Senior Digital Communications Officer to join the Communications Team at the Diocese.

In this influential role, you will lead the development and delivery of digital content across the website, social media channels and wider digital platforms, helping to communicate the life and mission of one of the largest dioceses in the Church of England.

Position: Senior Digital Communications Officer

Location: Kidlington, Oxford/hybrid

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week (part-time, 0.8 FTE considered)

Salary: £42,685.33 - £45,968.81 per annum pro rata

Contract: Permanent

Closing Date: Midnight on Wednesday 9 December 2026

Interview Date: Tuesday 15 December 2026, Oxford

The Role

Working within a small, energetic communications team, you will help ensure that staff, churches and communities are supported by engaging, effective and audience-focused communications. Reporting to the Head of Communications, you will oversee digital content across all communications channels, ensuring content is compelling, accurate, accessible and aligned with communications priorities. You will play a key role in implementing the diocesan communications strategy, while also creating and commissioning high-quality content including articles, photography, video, podcasts and social media campaigns.

As Senior Digital Communications Officer, you will:
- Lead the creation, commissioning and management of digital content across the Diocese's digital channels.
- Produce and source engaging multimedia content including photography, film, podcasts and live-streamed content.
- Ensure the diocesan website and social media channels remain fresh, relevant and audience-focused.
- Use analytics and audience insight to improve digital performance and inform future communications activity.
- Support colleagues across the Diocese with digital communications campaigns and best practice.
- Build engagement with churches, clergy and local communities through effective use of digital and social media.

Please note that this is a full-time post but we would be happy to consider applicants who may prefer 0.8 FTE.

About You

We are looking for a highly organised and creative communications professional with strong digital expertise and a passion for engaging audiences through compelling content.

You will bring:
- Experience delivering successful digital communications and social media campaigns.
- Strong content creation skills across a range of digital formats and platforms.
- Knowledge of website content management, SEO, user journeys and digital analytics.
- Experience working collaboratively with stakeholders to develop communications solutions and campaigns.
- Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Strong IT skills and experience using communications, photography and video editing tools.
- The ability to build positive working relationships and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment.

You do not need to be a practising Christian to work with us. Around half of staff are not practising Christians, but all are comfortable working within the Christian ethos and values that underpin this work.

Benefits and Rewards:
- 25 days holiday per annum, rising each year by one day to a maximum of 30 days
- In addition to the statutory UK public holidays, the Diocese offers three additional discretionary leave days
- Hybrid working
- Generous employer pension contribution of 12.5%, including 1% death in service benefit (5% Employee Contribution)
- Access to wellbeing support via Employee Assistance Programme
- Enhanced family friendly policies and a generous sick pay provision
- Access to low interest financial services from Churches Mutual Credit Union including loans
- Opportunities for professional development and training
- A supportive and collaborative working environment committed to helping people flourish

The successful candidate must have the right to live and work in the United Kingdom. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interviews. We are particularly keen to receive applications from UK Minority Ethnic / Global Majority heritage and disabled candidates, who are currently underrepresented.

You may have experience in other areas such as Digital, Digital Marketing, Digital Communications, Marketing and Communications, Digital Officer, Digital Marketing Officer, Digital Communications Officer, Marketing and Communications Officer, Senior Digital Officer, Senior Digital Marketing Officer, Senior Digital Communications Officer, Senior Marketing and Communications Officer.

Please note this role is advertised by the recruitment agency acting for the client, Not For Profit People.

title: Travel Marketing Executive
description:
Travel Marketing Executive
Company Overview
An established marketing and public relations agency specialising in international destination marketing, tourism and travel. Working with high-profile UK and international clients, the business delivers a range of sales, marketing, PR and event management services to raise destination awareness, strengthen industry relationships and drive commercial results. Based on the outskirts of Banbury, the agency offers a collaborative and fast-paced working environment.
About the Role
Are you a marketing professional with a creative approach, a passion for travel and a willingness to travel overseas?
This is an excellent opportunity to join an established agency, working with international destinations and clients across the travel and tourism industry.
You will manage multiple client accounts and deliver integrated marketing and PR campaigns, building relationships with leading travel operators, media contacts and commercial partners. Responsibilities will range from coordinating promotional campaigns and securing media coverage to delivering presentations, attending industry events and accompanying clients on overseas familiarisation trips.
We're looking for someone who is highly organised, proactive and confident managing projects, with excellent communication skills, a creative approach and a genuine passion for travel and tourism. Previous marketing experience is important, while experience in B2 B marketing, PR or account management would be advantageous.
Duties & Responsibilities
- Plan, coordinate and deliver national marketing campaigns and promotional activity to increase awareness of client destinations, identifying opportunities for creative partnerships with UK and international brands.
- Manage multiple client accounts, acting as a key point of contact and ensuring campaigns and activities are delivered effectively in line with client objectives.
- Develop and coordinate PR campaigns to generate positive media coverage, raise destination awareness and secure exposure across national, regional and specialist publications.
- Build relationships with tour operators, travel agents and industry partners, coordinating sales activity to secure destination representation in holiday brochures and online travel packages.
- Organise and accompany familiarisation trips, attend industry events and deliver destination training and presentations to travel trade professionals and media representatives.
- Manage client budgets, monitor campaign performance and media coverage, prepare monthly reports and communicate progress and results to senior management.

Experience & Skills required
- Previous experience in a marketing role, with an understanding of marketing campaigns and promotional activity.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Creative, organised and proactive, with strong attention to detail.
- Confident building relationships and communicating with different audiences.
- Able to manage multiple tasks, work to deadlines and use initiative.
- A genuine passion for travel and tourism, with a willingness to learn and develop within the industry.
- Experience in B2 B marketing, PR or the travel industry would be advantageous.

Additional Information
- Salary: £32,500 per annum.
- Contract: Full-time, permanent.
- Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am 5pm, with occasional evening and weekend commitments. Flexibility is required to accommodate client and industry events.
- Location: Office-based, on the outskirts of Banbury, with regular travel to meetings and events across the UK and Ireland, including Manchester, London and Dublin.
- Travel Requirements: A full, clean driving licence, access to your own vehicle and a valid passport are essential. The successful candidate must be confident driving independently in the UK and internationally and willing to undertake overseas travel.

Interested?
If you have marketing experience, a creative approach and a genuine passion for travel, we'd love to hear from you. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your skills, work with international destinations and turn your love of travel into a rewarding career.
Apply today or, for a confidential discussion about the opportunity, contact Zoe Edwards on (phone number removed) or email (url removed).
